abstract: PURPOSE: Recently, high-dose chemotherapy with peripheral blood stem cell (PBSC) rescue has been developed for poor risk testicular germ cell cancer. In this study, we investigated the optimum timing for harvesting PBSCs with the use of bleomycin + etoposide + cisplatin (BEP) chemotherapy, which is a well known first-line regimen for the testicular cancer. MATERIAL AND METHOD: Peripheral blood CD34-positive cell ratios were measured during a total of 10 courses of BEP chemotherapy in 6 patients with metastatic germ cell cancer between 1996 and 1998. We performed 4 apheresis in 3 patients during this period. Recombinant human granulocyte-colony stimulating factor (rhG-CSF) was administrated from the day on which the neutrophil count decreased less than 1,000/microliter. RESULTS: The peripheral blood CD34-positive cell ratios became maximum (3.0-24.6%; average 10.0%) on the day 18 to 21 (median day 19) of BEP chemotherapy with rhG-CSF administration. The maximum ratios of peripheral blood CD34 positive cells were achieved when the number of leukocyte were 6,880-23,600/microliter and exceeded 6,000/microliter after the 18th day of BEP chemotherapy. The average number of collected CD34 positive cells was 9.5 x 10(6)/kg at a single apheresis, and 12.6 x 10(6)/kg per patient. CONCLUSION: Efficient hematopoietic progenitor cells were mobilized by BEP chemotherapy with rhG-CSF administration of first-line setting. Our results suggest that the optimum timing of PBSCs harvest is the day when the numbers of leukocyte exceed 6,000/microliter after the 18th day of BEP chemotherapy and the following day.
abstract_ja: 目的：予後不良の精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対し、末梢血幹細胞救援を伴う大量化学療法が開発されてきた。本研究では、精巣がんの標準的一次治療として知られるブレオマイシン+エトポシド+シスプラチン(BEP)化学療法を用いた末梢血幹細胞採取の至適時期を検討した。対象と方法：1996年から1998年に転移性胚細胞腫瘍の6例に対しBEP化学療法の計10コースを施行し、末梢血CD34陽性細胞比率を測定した。3例で期間中に4回のアフェレーシスを実施した。好中球数が1,000/μL未満に低下した日からrhG-CSFを投与した。結果：rhG-CSF投与下のBEP化学療法の第18～21日(中央値第19日)に末梢血CD34陽性細胞比率は最大となった(3.0～24.6%、平均10.0%)。最大比率は白血球数6,880～23,600/μLの時に得られ、第18日以降は6,000/μLを超えていた。1回のアフェレーシスで採取されたCD34陽性細胞の平均数は9.5×10^6/kg、患者1人あたり合計12.6×10^6/kgであった。結論：一次治療としてrhG-CSFを併用したBEP化学療法により、効率よく造血前駆細胞が動員された。末梢血幹細胞採取の至適時期は、BEP化学療法第18日以降に白血球数が6,000/μLを超えた日およびその翌日であると考えられる。
